blocks.content:
When calibration succeeds, the watcher starts running on its own at the interval you set in **Repeats**. **Next run** and **Cadence** at the top of the watcher's page show when it runs next and how often.

**Run now** adds one extra run right away, so you don't have to wait for the next automatic run. The **Active** switch at the top of the page turns the automatic runs on and off. Turning it off pauses the watcher without deleting it.

Runs don't overlap. If a run is already in progress, the next one waits or is skipped.

blocks.content:
Optional: Turn off the **Active** switch, to the left of **Run now**.

This pauses the automatic runs without deleting the watcher.

Optional: Turn the **Active** switch back on.

The watcher keeps running on its schedule.
You triggered **Run now**, and the new run appears at the top of the **Run history** tab. You also know how to pause the automatic runs. In the next milestone, you'll review the run report.
